invariant: The clean public root passes the repository's local quality and packaging checks
excerpt: Local checks passed on the sanitised source: formatting, lint, Effect policy, type checks, unused-code checks, tests and builds. Direct packages were current at resolution time, and the audited dependency tree reported no known vulnerabilities. No provider write or Instapaper bookmark change ran.
recovery: Rerun bun install --frozen-lockfile, bun run verification and bun audit on the recorded public root.
postcondition: The clean public source, contracts, tests and builds passed their configured local checks.
limitations: Local verification does not prove the current source is deployed.
Local verification does not authenticate to Cloudflare or Instapaper.
nonClaims: This does not prove provider state or an authenticated hosted journey.
No Instapaper bookmark was saved or changed.
